value.text: Portrait drawing at Mantua, winter 1499 to 1500

claims.statement: Leonardo drew her at Mantua after leaving Milan; a later letter of 1501 refers to the drawing. The Louvre cartoon is identified with this portrait by interpretation.

value.text: Correspondence through Fra Pietro da Novellara, 27 March to 14 April 1501

claims.statement: She wrote to Novellara from Mantua on 27 March 1501; he replied from Florence on 3 and 14 April 1501. Archivio di Stato di Mantova.
